g.text: Right = more gain • Down = less damage
Step 3: gain on visited cubes versus training-validation damage
Partial figure: three points; seed SD error bars; one fixed visiting order (290 → 319).
Horizontal errors are SDs of paired per-seed gains, averaged over all 30 current-cube scores;
vertical errors are SDs of paired differences from Plain on training-cube validation after visit 30.
A’s damage is constant across visits: its offset from Plain comes from the two-part base network,
not from adaptation. All 15 z-grid settings are omitted here and listed as unavailable in the CSV.
Saved results only. Gain uses successive model states; it is not a final-model rescore of all 30 cubes.
